- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0fea05fe3d7d5234b32e2c6d55f4dd1584758ed6` → `packageMentionDocs`.

```sh

git fetch origin 5f41aaae9ddcd140bec223351214dfbccda00328 && git checkout 5f41aaae9ddcd140bec223351214dfbccda00328

git fetch origin 0fea05fe3d7d5234b32e2c6d55f4dd1584758ed6 de2fedcb7692a84e5fa323014f580ad5e25f79c5 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0fea05fe3d7d5234b32e2c6d55f4dd1584758ed6 && git merge --no-ff de2fedcb7692a84e5fa323014f580ad5e25f79c5
```

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `de2fedcb7692a84e5fa323014f580ad5e25f79c5`
Local-runs: none

Head unchanged since dispatch (`de2fedcb76`, branch `claude/issue-22664-mcp-error-code-provenance`, merge base `243dd3c625`; `origin/main` read at `0fea05fe3d`, the PR's base sha). Net diff: 4 files, +164/−17 — `.changeset/22664-spec-ledger-mcp-exposure-codes.md` (new), `packages/spec/scripts/check-error-code-provenance.ts`, its `.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`. No governed-surface path. Head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (internal, not a fork); PR is a draft, auto-merge unarmed, 181 changed lines.

**Check-runs on the head at read time (2026-10-10):** 13 `success` — `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check PR Size`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Auto Label`, `filter`; 3 `skipped` — `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`; **16 still `in_progress`** — `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `Test Core (1/6 … 6/6)`, `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3 … 3/3)`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · consumer gates`. The provenance guard itself is a step of `Lint & Repo Gates` (`lint.yml` `Error-code provenance guard`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance`), so the gate's CI verdict on this head is not yet in. This record judges the diff; the landing still waits on those 16 concluding `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` gains `'@objectstack/mcp': ['OBJECT_API_DISABLED', 'OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED']` — RIGHT.** Read at `origin/main`: `packages/mcp/package.json` is `@objectstack/mcp`; `stdio-data-bridge.ts:207-208` declare the two constants, `exposureError()` (`:220-231`) does `err.code = code`, and `enforceApiExposure` throws it with `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`/404 (`:296-300`) and `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`/405 with `allowedOperations` (`:309-314`). Both codes are genuinely stamped by this package; the row lists exactly those two and nothing else `@objectstack/mcp` stamps (a grep of `packages/mcp/src` for `OBJECT_API_` finds no third). The `door: 'none'` reading is TRUE on both reachability paths, not only the one the row comment names: the stdio data tools catch and answer `errorResult(messageOf(err))` (`mcp-http-tools.ts:604-990`, message only; `errorResultFromThrown`, which preserves `code`, serves only `run_action`/`resume_run`, neither gated by `enforceApiExposure`), and the ADR-0101 `record_by_id` resource's catch returns `{ error: message }` (`mcp-server-runtime.ts:1259-1267`). No MCP result carries the string code today. The owner key satisfies the ledger test's `^@objectstack\/[a-z0-9-]+$` pin; `ErrorCode`/`REGISTERED_ERROR_CODES` are unchanged since both codes were already registered under `@objectstack/rest` (ledger `:260-261`).

**(b) `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` gains `@objectstack/types → UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `registeredUnder: '@objectstack/cloud-connection'` — RIGHT, and it admits exactly one pair.** The shared-constant reasoning is true: `packages/types/src/unique-scope-install-gate.ts:336` exports `GLOBAL_UNIQUE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED = 'UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED'`; its only stamp is `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1225` (`code: GLOBAL_UNIQUE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, imported at `:99`), and the only other reference in `packages/*/src` is the CLI's comparison `res.body?.error?.code === '…'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts:184`), a reader, not a stamp. All three liveness directions the gate holds (`deriveFindings`) are satisfied: `@objectstack/cloud-connection` lists the code (ledger `:1071`), `@objectstack/types`' own row does not (`:939-957`), and the widened scan now finds the site (`types:336`). The gate keys waivers by `${package} → ${code}` with duplicates refused, so the entry admits one pair by construction. It is the same class as the `UPDATE_ID_MISMATCH` precedent (ledger header `:1773-1777`, "shared constructor one package over"); the gate's own header at the head now names both. A row under `@objectstack/types` instead would have been wrong — types ships no door — and without this waiver the widened gate reds on `main` (the dev measured 3 violations with the ledger untouched; see (c)).

**(c) The widened `constdef` pattern — RIGHT: a strict superset of the old rule, precise, and no phantom site on this tree.** The new limb is `const|let|var NAME [: T] = 'CODE'`; the second limb is byte-identical to the old `*_CODE` regex, so every old match is still a match (a `const MY_CODE = …` is consumed once by the first limb at the same line and code — no double count). Precision: the first limb requires a declaration keyword plus an identifier before `=` and a quote immediately after `=\s*`, so a comparison (`=== '`), a bare re-assignment, a ternary or `??` operand and a destructuring default cannot match — the new self-test cases and vitest pins hold exactly those negatives. Cross-check, read-only: a `git grep -P` of the head tree with the published regex, filtered by the gate's own `isScannable` rules and attributed by nearest `package.json`, tallied in scratch (no gate run): 47 registered `constdef` sites = 36 old-limb + 11 new-only, 0 old-limb sites lost, 0 violations, 2 waived (`UPDATE_ID_MISMATCH`, `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`). The 11 new-only sites are exactly the dev's table (mcp ×2, plugin-auth ×3, service-analytics ×3, spec ×2, types ×1), and each reaches a stamp position in its file (`code: CONST`, `err.code = CONST`, `readonly code = CONST`, `params: { code: CONST }`). The one-count gap against the dev's 37/48 is my per-line grep missing `objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts:390`, whose literal sits on the next line and which the gate's `\s*` spans — consistent with their numbers, not a discrepancy. Comment masking is the gate's shared `maskComments`, so the one prose mention found (`record-validator.ts:204`, a block comment) is not a site.

**(d) "No new gate" — HELD.** No new script, package script, CI step or baseline: `STAMP_PATTERNS` keeps its three names (`objlit`, `assign`, `constdef`); the `lint.yml` step is untouched; the self-test floors rise 4→6 and 2→4 to match the four added cases (17 cases across 5 batteries, as reported). The header's declared blind set shrinks by one shape (non-`*_CODE` constants) and now states the attribution bound (site attributed to the DEFINING package), which the `printBounds` line also prints. Triage asked for one rule covering every measured miss; widening by initializer does that where renaming would have covered one.

**(e) Pins — the card's pin is held permanently.** The vitest `@objectstack/mcp` block drives the bridge's two declarations verbatim through `scanSourceText` and the REAL ledger, then removes the `@objectstack/mcp` key and asserts both become violations with no waiver standing in. Observation, non-blocking: the block copies the two lines rather than reading `packages/mcp` (correct under `check:cross-package-test-inputs`), so a rename in the bridge would not move this test — the repo-wide CI gate is the holder, and the test's comment says so.

### ② Semver level

**`@objectstack/spec: minor` with `Clause-②: yes` — RIGHT.** The published face moves: the `as const` type of `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` gains the key `'@objectstack/mcp'` (the dev measured it on the built `.d.ts`; `typeof ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` is consumed only by the ledger's own test and the `ErrorCode` derivation, which is unchanged), and `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` changes in value only. That is a purely additive widening of a published package's public surface, which under the launch-window rule takes at least `minor`; nothing is removed or renamed, so no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition is owed. `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s level axis reads the PR-body `Clause-②: yes` and requires at least one package whose `packages/**/src/**` the diff moves to grade `minor` or above — `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` moves and `@objectstack/spec` is `minor`, so the predicate is satisfied; `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on this head. The changeset body carries the `Clause-②: yes` line and the same reading as the PR body; omitting the optional `(widening)` arm is permitted (at most one arm). A `fix(spec)` title with a `minor` grade is allowed (the commit type may raise a bump, never lower it).

### ③ Boundary flags

The `os-dev-report` (comment `6098263130`) has `open_questions: []`. Its deviations and notes, each answered:

1. **Waiver entry beyond the claim's named rows** — ANSWERED, accepted. It is in the declared file (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts`), forced by the one-rule widening (the `types:336` site is new to the scan and `types` is not its door), and verified in ①(b). This record is the contract review the claim said the ledger change owes.
2. **Second code `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`** — ANSWERED, inside the claim: the file surface admits "any other code the measurement finds that `@objectstack/mcp` stamps unledgered", and the stamp is real (`stdio-data-bridge.ts:309-314`).
3. **Merge of `origin/main` (`b6ba2fefe6`)** — ANSWERED. A merge, not a rebase of a shared branch; the net diff against the merge base is the four files; none of the four is a generated artifact, so no os-regen deferral could be owed. The one later `main` commit (`0fea05fe3d`) touches none of the four files (`git diff --stat` between `243dd3c625` and `0fea05fe3d` over them is empty); the queue rebuilds on current `main`.
4. **Model-free commit trailers and the session-URL PR footer** — ANSWERED, not a deviation: AGENTS.md's rule (the pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in that pair), followed correctly.
5. **`check:pm-dispatch-gates` run without its exit code captured** — ANSWERED, non-blocking: the gate verdicts of record are the head's check-runs, and that family rides `Lint & Repo Gates`, which is `in_progress` at read time. The seat confirms its conclusion is `success` before queueing.
6. **Worktree cleanup; report posted from the shared checkout via `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, no file written there** — noted, nothing to adjudicate.

Out-of-scope notes (carrier: none, not filed) — the carrier is RIGHT for both: **class-field stamps** (39 sites, all listed, 0 violations) are a gate-population widening the gate header reserves for its own card, and with zero violations there is no defect to file; the **unseen-literal census** is raw, unadjudicated context (comparisons, types and `z.enum` lists are not emissions). The one thread worth a seat decision: the helper-call shape (plugin-auth's `FORBIDDEN`/`NOT_FOUND` handed to its error helpers in a package that does not list them) is the same filing class as this card and a declared blind shape of the gate; the seat may open a measurement card for it. Not a condition of this verdict.

Reviewer's own flags, non-blocking: the `@objectstack/mcp` row comment names the tool-layer flattening but not the record resource's (`mcp-server-runtime.ts:1259-1267`), which flattens too — the reading holds either way. The PR is a draft with `mergeable_state: blocked` on the running checks: ready first, arm second, only once every required context concludes `success`.
